name: @jiscribe/plugin-gcp-shapes
description: Provides the gcpIcon shape (the Google Cloud product icons: the core products' own icons and the category icons every other product is drawn with) as an external package built on the public canvas API alone (packages/canvas/docs/13-authoring-plugins.md)
